evidence: Has the Mining label and modifies src/node/miner.cpp, src/interfaces/mining.h, and src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp to add TxCollection.
rationale: Enables bandwidth-efficient template validation against the local mempool for Stratum v2 Job Declarator Servers. External miners currently face high memory and IPC bandwidth overhead because they must either mirror the mempool or transfer every full transaction, which this interface eliminates.
